people.name: Priyanka Singhal
people.title: Founder and Chief Executive Officer
people.prior_role: DRDO intern; family business at Charmachan Hospitality LLP
people.background: Electronics and Communication Engineering degree from Amritsar; DRDO intern exposed to warhead electronics and explosive initiation systems; bootstrapped venture using personal savings; traded electronic components and undertook college projects early on

financials.source_title: AMMUNIC SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED MCA filings
financials.notes: MCA FY25 revenue of ₹100 — likely reflects only the corporate shell entity; actual operating revenue is significantly higher per press reports

financials.source_title: 100 Emerging Women Leaders: How Priyanka Singhal broke barriers in defence tech
financials.notes: Projected revenue of ₹40 crore for FY24-25 per YourStory; company valuation rising to ₹250 crore
Tracxn latest revenue USD figure; likely reflects MCA filing discrepancy

traction.notes: Order book of ₹15 crore as reported by founder Priyanka Singhal to The Hindu BusinessLine
Supplied 155 fuses to Indian Army per CEO interview in Sep 2024
Company manufactures 7-8 defence products; 4 systems delivered for land warfare, 9 under development
First major order secured in 2023 from defence agencies including DRDO

products.name: Skanda system
products.description: Loitering munition system; current focus product for expansion

products.name: Advanced electronic fusing system
products.description: Patented advanced electronic fusing system designed to replace legacy mechanical fuses used in underwater operations; filed patent

products.name: Smart fusing systems for UAVs
products.description: Electronic fusing systems for unmanned aerial vehicles

products.name: Anti-tank mine (3rd version)
products.description: Anti-tank mine incorporating AI and sensors; third version under development

products.name: Underwater electronic fuzes
products.description: Electronic fuses for underwater/submarine operations; India's first fully indigenous electronic fusing system for underwater munitions targeting submarines

products.name: Naval mines & munitions
products.description: Munitions for naval applications including AUVs/USVs
